§6Americium-241§f

§aFive-year RTG pellets. The ultimate passive power source.§f

Americium-241 is a rare radioisotope produced only by the decay of §bPu-241§f in RBMK reactors. Useful for late-game power generation and nuclear fuel.

Properties: §e8.5§f RAD/s, radiation emitter, hard difficulty.

Production via SILEX: Short-Lived Nuclear Waste + BiSmUTh crystal gives 25% Am-241, 35% Am-242, etc. Reactor Grade Americium gives 33% Am-241, 66% Am-242.

Uses: §bRBMK Fuel§f (Low, Medium, and Highly Enriched Americium rods; HEA-241 uses fast neutrons), §bRTG Pellet§f (20 thermal power for §e3.384B§f ticks, over 5 real years, §e67.68B§f HE total, decays to Neptunium), §bSelf-Charging Battery§f (20 HE/tick).

§ePS:§f Americium-241 RTG pellets are the most powerful passive power source. Each lasts over 5 real years. Start Pu-241 RBMK fuel to produce americium.
